quirks: URL path says gemini-3-flash and the returned model is google/gemini-3-flash-preview-20251217, despite the registry name 'Gemini 2.0 Flash' — the live model is actually Gemini 3 Flash preview.
Response is a flat object with the answer at body.content (not OpenAI-style choices[].message.content).
usage.guide: POST to the URL with a JSON body {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}. Payment is x402 USDC on Base (~$0.012/call), no API key. Read the model's reply from body.content. Token/cost accounting is under body.usage.
